extension.description: View and edit CSV, TSV, TAB, XLSX, and ODS files in VS Code. Search, sort, filter, edit formulas, and save supported files. XLSM files open read-only.
config.csv.commentPrefix: Prefix that identifies CSV comments at the start of a record. Use an empty string to disable comments.
config.stdin.openStdin: Automatically opens a read-only preview for the compatible CSV buffer created from VS Code standard input (code -).
config.csv.firstRowHeader: Uses the first data row as the visual label for CSV columns.
config.csv.headerCase: Visual transformation applied to CSV header labels.
config.csv.showRowActions: Shows actions to insert, append, and delete CSV records in the editor.
config.xlsx.showStructureActions: Shows actions to insert and delete rows or columns in compatible XLSX workbooks.
config.xlsx.allowFormulaEditing: Allows creating and editing XLSX formulas through explicit formula editing mode.
config.xlsx.showFormulaAssistance: Shows suggestions for tested functions and explicit insertion of XLSX references.
config.xlsx.showFormulaFillActions: Shows actions to copy relative XLSX formulas down or to the right.
config.xlsx.showTableActions: Shows the action to create native tables in compatible XLSX ranges.
config.xlsx.showSheetActions: Shows actions to add, rename, or delete sheets in compatible XLSX workbooks.
config.xlsx.showStyleActions: Shows actions to apply simple formatting, merge cells, and save frozen panes in compatible XLSX workbooks.
config.view.restoreState: Restores and saves selection, scroll, search, and sizes for each file and sheet.
config.view.showResetButton: Shows the button to reset the spreadsheet view.
config.view.showClearSortButton: Shows the button to remove all active sort criteria.
config.view.showCopyButtons: Shows controls to copy the selection as TSV.
config.view.showMoveActions: Shows actions to cut and move ranges within the sheet.
config.view.showFillActions: Shows the action to fill ranges with repeated values or numeric series.
config.view.showDisplayModeButton: Shows the button to switch between raw values and Excel number formats in XLSX.
config.view.showWorkbookAppearance: Applies basic styles and merged XLSX/ODS cells in the grid.
config.edit.saveOnCommit: Automatically saves each confirmed change. When disabled, save with Ctrl/Cmd+S.
